description:
Role Overview
SmartOSC is seeking a Project Manager to lead the delivery of software project for our Japanese enterprise client. You will be the primary owner of delivery quality, timeline, budget, and client relationship — working directly with Japanese stakeholders while coordinating offshore engineering teams in Vietnam channels.
Key Deliverables & Responsibilities
* Own end-to-end delivery of one software project for Japanese clients, ensuring scope, schedule, cost, and quality targets are met.
* Serve as the main point of contact for Japanese client stakeholders — running meetings, reporting, and escalations directly in Japanese.
* Lead project planning, resource allocation, risk management, and change management across the project lifecycle.
* Manage and grow cross-functional offshore teams (BrSE, developers, QA, BA), setting clear expectations and removing blockers.
* Translate client business goals into clear delivery plans and coordinate alignment between client expectations and the offshore team.
* Track and report project health (progress, budget, risks, KPIs) to internal leadership.
* Standardize delivery practices, manage interdependencies across projects, and drive continuous improvement.
requirements_text:
* 4+ years in software project delivery, with at least 2 years in a Project Manager/ Project Coordinator, Scum Master, BrSE... role managing offshore or distributed teams.
* Proven track record delivering projects for Japanese clients.
* Business-level Japanese (JLPT N2 or above; N1 strongly preferred) — able to lead client meetings, negotiate, and report in Japanese.
* Intermediate English skills
* Strong command of project management methodologies (Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid) and tools (e.g., Jira, Redmine, MS Project).
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skill
Nice to have:
* PMP, or equivalent certification.
* Experience working or living in Japan
